title: ADP SBS Digital Sales: Recap and Next Steps

voiceover.text: Thanks for the time today. Here's a quick recap of what we covered, and how we move forward.
The big takeaway: SBS Digital doesn't have a demand problem. It has a capacity problem.
New reps leave before they ramp, and the ones who stay spend too little of their day actually selling.
Cut first-year attrition by ten points, and we win back about twelve sellers of capacity, without adding headcount.
The plan comes down to four priorities. Keep the sellers we hire. Give reps their time back. Route the right buyer, fast. And compete on ease.
All on one operating model and one dashboard, so every site works from the same numbers.
The economics: three point one million invested, three point seven million in new year-one bookings, and payback around month six.
From here, the first thirty days are about listening and setting the baseline. By sixty, we pilot. By ninety, we scale what works.
Five decisions will shape year one, and we'd love your input on each. Thank you.
